Ishtar Punjabi presents the Punjabi Songs 2021 "Pani Di Gal" (ਾੀ ੀ ) from the album by Maninder Buttar & Asees Kaur. Featuring Jasmin Bhasin.Lyrics by Maninder Buttar. Music by MixSingh. Directed by Robby Singh. Produced By Gunbir Singh Sidhu & Manmord Sidhu. In this song, the boy is convincing his love to say yes to him.
Credits :
Song : Pani Di Gal
Singer/Lyrics/Composer : Maninder Buttar
Female Lead : Jasmin Bhasin
Female Vocals : Asees Kaur
Music : MixSingh
Music Composed/Arranged/Programmed & Mixed by: MixSingh
